description: As an analyst I can surface PowerShell script block logging events so I can see deobfuscated PowerShell commands executed on the host
steps: wt-evtx timeline -d <dir> includes Event ID 4104 (ScriptBlockLogging) entries with the script block text
wt-evtx timeline -d <dir> includes Event ID 4103 (ModuleLogging) entries
script block text is truncated to 200 chars in text output with a '...' suffix
full script block text is preserved in JSONL output
Event ID 4104 entries with Suspicious flag in MessageNumber are annotated as [SUSPICIOUS] in text output
